notes: Copilot rewinds IN PLACE on the SAME session id — /undo (alias /rewind) ends in sessionTruncateEventsBeforeEventId, which truncates the session's own event history and rebuilds its projection; it never calls clearHistory, so no new session-state/<id>/ directory is minted (contrast 1-5 session-reset, where /clear DOES rotate the id). The spec therefore mirrors the claudecode in-place sibling, re-anchored onto this column's two-phase presession birth (proc-<PID> row first, then the real <session-id> once events.jsonl appears on the first prompt). The rewind ITSELF is asserted only as 'the session stays in ready': session.snapshot_rewind is emitEphemeral, so it is not persisted, and no state-changing event reaches the daemon. PROVISIONAL — whether the truncation physically shrinks events.jsonl is unverified (the truncate lives in the compressed Node-SEA native addon; the JS layer exposes only an append primitive). If it does shrink, the tailer's rotation/rewrite detection replays from byte 0 and the recording MAY show one extra working→ready blip between v2_turn_end and v3_turn_start; that blip is deliberately NOT asserted here, because the scenario requires only the arc. model is NOT pinned: --model accepts only auto and session.auto_mode_resolved routes per turn between gpt-5-mini and claude-haiku-4.5.

text: proc-<PID> pre-session appears in ready shortly after launch (the copilot process exists while the session dir still holds only workspace.yaml)

assistant.turn_end settles the first turn back to ready

Spec: 'Subsequent turns start cleanly from the rewound point: ready → working'. The third prompt drives the SAME session (no new_session — an in-place rewind must not mint a session id)
